events.title: Fantasy, Process, and AI Usage | Devlog
events.summary: Hello alchemists and apprentices! We wanted to dive a bit into what motivated the creation of Potions Galore. The whole game revolves around one idea, that acted as our guiding light: “What if you actually were in an Alchemist’s house-shop, and you’d have all these potions that someone worked hard to make, and you’d be able to read about them in an exhaustive tome?”So that’s what we did.
